title: Spacing, radius, color and type size come from --studio-* design tokens
statement: Component stylesheets reference the `--studio-*` and `--font-*` custom properties defined once in `frontend/src/styles.css`; they do not hardcode pixel spacing/sizing, hex colors, or font sizes that a token already covers. `border: 1px solid ...` hairlines are the one accepted raw-`px` exception.
rationale: This is the operator-observed defect class: ad-hoc styles instead of design tokens. `frontend/src/styles.css` already defines a full scale (`--studio-space-1..4`, `--studio-radius-*`, `--studio-font-size-*`, theme-aware colors under `:root[data-theme]`). Every raw literal that duplicates a token value is a value the theme system can't retheme and a reviewer can't tell apart from an intentional one-off.

good.caption: Spacing, radius and color all sourced from tokens.

bad.caption: Raw px sizing and a raw hex gradient with no token equivalent.
